notes: Headless read facade over SQLite and the v10 query helpers. Unfiltered, ungrouped list pages delegate to PagedLibraryReader so ordering, LIMIT and OFFSET run in SQL and only the requested window is loaded; text search, filters and grouping keep the one-snapshot v10 in-memory path. The default text order is SQLite NOCASE via PagedLibraryComparer, replacing the earlier current-culture comparer.
